questions: Compare global versus scoped context and validated directional learnings.
Measure repeated prefixes, assigned-read enforcement and anchoring from prior errors.
decision: Use bounded assigned context and directional, evidence-backed learnings; keep hypotheses separate from normative contracts.
code_observations: The current context system separates universal context, task-scoped context and directional learnings. The production worker prompt is built by runner_contract.
Useful worktree changes and completed subtasks survive a worker; transcripts are not the intended cross-task memory.

symbols.name: ## 1. Avoid the harness when the harness does not pay for itself
## 2. Keep useful shared context while it is useful

implementation_steps: Attach a provenance hash, producing task, applicable consumers and expiry/invalidation rule to each reusable learning.
Load only universal constraints and the receiving task's assigned entries. Repeated conventions used by multiple tasks belong in a versioned pattern, not copied learning prose.
Require deterministic evidence before promoting a failed worker's hypothesis into a reusable fact. Keep disproven hypotheses clearly labeled and bounded.
Add a compact context accounting receipt: selected file IDs, byte counts and reason for inclusion, without retaining prompts or secrets.
Keep static prompt rules stable across tasks; append task-specific evidence afterward. Test cache structure but measure actual cache usage per host rather than assuming an exact hit.
proposed_acceptance_tests: An unrelated task cannot receive a learning merely because it ran later.
Changing a cited file invalidates or flags the learning before reuse.
A malicious or unsupported note cannot alter acceptance, permissions or provider policy.
The universal context contains only constraints needed by all tasks and remains within its existing budget.
Byte-stable prefixes and bounded task suffixes survive different task IDs and prior failure lengths.

alternatives.title: Carry forward all conversation history
alternatives.tradeoff: Maximal recall but repeated tokens and unrelated or misleading context.

alternatives.title: Assigned evidence-backed memory with invalidation
alternatives.tradeoff: Small useful state, explicit provenance and less anchoring risk.

alternatives.title: Automatically turn every failure narrative into a global rule
alternatives.tradeoff: Cheap writing creates unbounded stale context and can propagate an incorrect diagnosis.

cost_model: Measure re-read source bytes, assignment size and acceptance regressions. Reuse is valuable only when it avoids rediscovery without lowering correctness; do not promise a universal token reduction.
unverified: Research on memory/context reports workload-specific gains, not proof for this repository. Independent implementation review remains necessary.
runtime_experiments: No authenticated model calls; tests listed here are implementation obligations, not claimed passes.
